Pass `title` and `description` when you create your `FastAPI` app. These are among the fields used in the OpenAPI specification and the automatic API docs UIs[2]:

- `title` (`str`): The title of the API.[2]
- `description` (`str`): A short description of the API.[2] It can use Markdown.[2]

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

description = """
ChimichangApp API helps you do awesome stuff. 🚀

## Items

You can **read items**.
"""

app = FastAPI(
    title="ChimichangApp",
    description=description,
    summary="Deadpool's favorite app. Nuff said.",
    version="0.0.1",
)
```

Any Markdown you write in `description` will be rendered in the output.[2]

You can also set other metadata here:
- `summary`: A short summary of the API.[2] It's available since OpenAPI 3.1.0, FastAPI 0.99.0.[2]
- `version`: The version of the API. This is the version of your own application, not of OpenAPI.[2]
- `terms_of_service`, `contact`, and `license_info`.
